chunks: Saad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Ja'far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithluhu' mean in Shia hadith literature regarding prayer rulings?
ai.summary: This is a concise 'ithbat' (confirmation) hadith within Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms that the preceding detailed rulings on prayer apply equally to the current context. It highlights the scholarly method of avoiding redundancy while ensuring comprehensive legal coverage, reinforcing the continuity of the Prophet’s and Imams’ teachings on the mechanics of *salat*. The chain of narrators, including Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim, underscores the reliability of the Kufan transmission tradition in Shia jurisprudence.
